state_matching.temperature_screening_rule: Candidate temperatures lie within the Vidrio 2022 nominal measurement-temperature range and above its reported melting-temperature central value; this is not thermodynamic-state matching.

qualification_boundary.warning: These are published first-principles simulation outputs, not experimental measurements or TR-EIP predictions. Cell-derived density is a distinct simulation observable. Do not use an experimental measurement range quoted in the source table as simulated density or uncertainty.
qualification_boundary.uncertainty_policy: No model uncertainty has been invented or inferred; the number of decimal places is not an uncertainty estimate.
qualification_boundary.composition_policy: The exact 2:1 formula-unit ratio differs from both 67:33 mol% and the ICP-MS measured 33.58 mol% BeF2. Do not silently relabel the compositions or claim a composition-exact match.
qualification_boundary.physical_state_policy: Overlapping temperatures alone do not establish equal composition, pressure, phase, normalization, or ensemble. Raw AIMD density comparison cannot validate a TR-EIP energy model.
